findings.text: The docstring says “each row in the context,” but the theorem quantifies over a separately supplied row list. Fix: Say that `anyMayFail` is false exactly when every listed expression evaluates without a fault on every listed row in the given context, which holds vacuously when either list is empty.

The status says both tests of `updateJsonReady` use `anyMayFail`, but the function also checks `RETURNING` expressions for fallible calls. Fix: Say that the row-wise lemma covers the `WHERE` and `SET` checks and that the separate `RETURNING` check still applies.

The status cites a passing local `just dev-build` check, although `AGENTS.md` permits status files to cite only Nix check results. Fix: Remove the local pass and record the applicable Nix result when it is available.
